evidence: Workbook (read in memory via zipfile): 'Quality Checks' row 38 and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 38 = #37 later_dimensions_tolerate_earlier_mutations, 'A later dimension doesn't assume a pristine seed after an earlier dimension mutated the shared running app.'; column E blank on both sheets, no comments/threaded comments, drawings carry no text. Skill references/quality-checks.md:153-154: look for state-relative wording (read current value, quote seeded expectation beside it, grade against what was observed). SHARED APP: tests/test.sh:104-113 starts ONE app/DB; run_suite (203-210) runs gates (213) then scored (224) against it with --max-concurrent-agent 1; no reseed between suites. Rewardkit 0.1.7 source in workspace (deliverables/colderwater-playground-devtools/final-cross-check-2026-09-27/harness/rewardkit-0.1.7-source/runner.py:199-203) sorts dimension dirs, so expected order is constraints, render, functional (14 individual sessions), polish, visual; not measured on this candidate. MUTATIONS AND TOLERANCE: (a) gates/constraints criterion adds a uniquely named card to seeded Data Analyst Applied and says 'find exactly one card for that candidate' (unique name, so not a count); every scored prompt's global gate does the same with a suffix (functional prompt.md:15, polish prompt.md:11, visual prompt.md:11). (b) app_context.md:27-31 (injected into all prompts by test.sh:195-201): 'Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count.' (c) functional prompt.md:21 'Shared state': own suffixed jobs/cards, never move records you did not create, never rely on a starting count except quoted seeded facts, never message/sign in as Lena except hro_unread_seen, clear any pre-existing draft text, Product Designer fallback with counts/orders/places read relative to state before acting, judge setup legs against the state the app actually produced. Same draft-clearing rule in polish prompt.md:14. SEEDED FACTS STILL QUOTED, each checked against every dimension that could run earlier: (1) hro_intake_restart reads Platform Engineer board order (Greta, Ade, Marco / Priya, Samuel) and Noor's note - matches seed (APP-105/106/108, APP-103/104, note on APP-101); no gate, functional, polish or visual step moves a PE card or adds a note to a seeded card (functional forbids moving others' records; polish/visual use own job or read-only; the PE conversation is touched only by messages). (2) hro_unread_seen: Lena's count 1 - seed APP-301 has 3 messages (2 staff, 1 Lena), Lena read_count 2 → 1; functional prompt.md:21 forbids messaging/signing in as Lena, polish prompt.md:24 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation', render gate opens no conversation, constraints gate sends nothing, visual is read-only ('Do not move cards or send messages'). (3) hro_candidate statuses: Noor PE Interview (APP-101), Noor PD Applied (APP-302), Tomas DA Screen (APP-201) - nothing moves these; the hro_messaging/hro_unread_seen fallbacks to Tomas's DA conversation add messages only and say 'counts relative to their values before you act'. (4) hro_long_thread explicitly 'earlier sessions may have added messages to it; read counts relative to what it holds'; Bar uses only relative facts (latest 30, pages of 30, remaining count). hro_pol_earlier_place/hro_pol_live_thread use Noor's PE thread relatively. (5) hro_intake_restart Bar 'seeded jobs appear once' tolerates added jobs. Restart is used once (hro_intake_restart) and later sessions sign in fresh and build their own state. BROKEN-APP PROBE: an app that reseeds or resets the DB on every request/restart would pass a pristine-only rubric but fails here because hro_intake_restart compares recorded own records after restart and 'seeded jobs appear once'. CONFORMING-ALTERNATIVE PROBE: a correct app whose state has been heavily mutated by earlier sessions is not penalised, since every count/order/place leg is relative or on the session's own records and pre-filled drafts are cleared. Residual (P3, not a defect): polish hro_pol_live_board's Product Designer fallback says 'move one other card of the job to Screen' and polish lacks functional's explicit 'never move records you did not create'; a judge could move Noor's seeded PD card (APP-302). Only reached when job opening is broken, and with the expected dir order (functional before polish) only visual follows, which is read-only and quotes no seeded stage, so no graded leg is affected. Colderwater lessons checked for this row: 15/16 (restart compares several recorded records relative to the pre-restart baseline; no double grading of other features) satisfied. Evidence limits: source-level review only; no full configured judge run, no Oracle/model score; raw-evidence-index.json scope states full configured grading is absent, and its scripted golden run does not exercise cross-dimension sequencing.
